title.en: An Act Excluding National Banks Organized Under the Laws of the United states From the Prohibition of Using the Word "National" as a Portion of their Name or

text.en:
Any law or part of a law heretofore enacted prohibiting the use of the word "national" by any
bank, corporation, firm or partnership shall not apply to any national bank organized under the laws of the
United States, the name of which is so distinctive that it could not reasonably be confused with the Philippine
National Bank.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 22, 1929.
